textbook.fa: درس ۲: نگاهی به آینده (بخش واژگان ترکیبی)

fa.question:
با توجه به بخش ترکیب‌های واژگانی درس دوم، جملهٔ زیر را کامل کنید:
⁦'We must take care of our planet and stop cutting down trees, because deforestation can cause serious _______ to wildlife.'⁩
fa.grading_key: - [1.0] برای یافتن و نوشتن املای صحیح واژهٔ کلیدی (⁦damage⁩)

en.question:
Based on the collocations section of lesson two, complete the following sentence:
'We must take care of our planet and stop cutting down trees, because deforestation can cause serious _______ to wildlife.'
en.grading_key: - [1.0] for correctly finding and spelling the collocation keyword (damage).

tr.question:
Ba tavajjoh be bakhsh-e loghat-haye tarkibi-ye dars-e dovom, jomleh-ye zir ra kamel konid:
'We must take care of our planet and stop cutting down trees, because deforestation can cause serious _______ to wildlife.'

textbook.fa: درس ۳: انرژی‌های تجدیدپذیر (گرامر: مجهول زمان حال کامل)
textbook.en: Lesson 3: Renewable Energy (Grammar: Present Perfect Passive)

fa.question:
جملهٔ زیر را با شکل صحیح مجهولِ حال کامل فعل داخل پرانتز کامل کنید:
⁦'Many solar power plants _______ (build) in desert areas recently.'⁩
fa.grading_key: - [1.0] برای ساختار مجهول حال کامل با فاعل جمع (⁦have been built⁩)
fa.final_resolution: ⁦Many solar power plants have been built in desert areas recently.⁩

en.question:
Complete the sentence with the Present Perfect Passive form of the verb in parentheses:
'Many solar power plants _______ (build) in desert areas recently.'
en.grading_key: - [1.0] for the plural Present Perfect Passive form (have been built).
en.final_resolution: Many solar power plants have been built in desert areas recently.

tr.question:
Jomleh-ye zir ra ba fe'l-e majhool-e hal-e kamel kamel konid:
'Many solar power plants _______ (build) in desert areas recently.'
tr.final_resolution: Many solar power plants have been built in desert areas recently.

textbook.fa: درس ۲: نگاهی به آینده (گرامر: بندهای موصولی)
textbook.en: Lesson 2: Look at the Future (Grammar: Relative Clauses)

fa.question:
دو جملهٔ زیر را با ضمیر موصولی مناسب (⁦who / which⁩) به یک جملهٔ مرکب تبدیل کنید:
⁦'The solar panels generate electricity. They were installed on the roof last week.'⁩
fa.grading_key:
- [0.5] برای حذف ضمیر تکراری (⁦They⁩) و انتخاب ضمیر موصولی اشیا (⁦which⁩)
- [0.5] برای آوردن بند موصولی درست بعد از اسم مرجع (⁦The solar panels⁩)
fa.final_resolution: ⁦The solar panels which were installed on the roof last week generate electricity.⁩

en.question:
Combine the two sentences into a single complex sentence using the appropriate relative pronoun (who or which):
'The solar panels generate electricity. They were installed on the roof last week.'
en.grading_key:
- [0.5] for omitting the repeated pronoun (They) and choosing the relative pronoun for things (which).
- [0.5] for placing the relative clause right after the noun it describes (The solar panels).
en.final_resolution: The solar panels which were installed on the roof last week generate electricity.

tr.question:
Do jomleh-ye zir ra ba estefadeh az zamir-e moosooli-ye monaseb (who ya which) be yek jomleh tabdil konid:
'The solar panels generate electricity. They were installed on the roof last week.'
tr.grading_key:
- [0.5] baraye hazf-e They va entekhab-e 'which'
- [0.5] baraye etesal-e sahih-e jomleh ba The solar panels
tr.final_resolution: The solar panels which were installed on the roof last week generate electricity.

fa.question:
با توجه به متن کتاب در مورد احترام به والدین، جملهٔ زیر را کامل کنید:
⁦'We should show great respect to our parents because they are the ones who brought us up with love and _______.'⁩
fa.grading_key: - [1.0] برای یافتن و نوشتن املای صحیح واژهٔ متن کتاب (⁦care⁩)

en.question:
Based on the textbook text regarding respect for parents, complete the following sentence:
'We should show great respect to our parents because they are the ones who brought us up with love and _______.'
en.grading_key: - [1.0] for correctly locating and spelling the authentic textbook vocabulary keyword (care).

tr.question:
Ba tavajjoh be matn-e ketab, jomleh-ye zir ra kamel konid:
'We should show great respect to our parents because they are the ones who brought us up with love and _______.'

fa.question:
با توجه به بخش ضرب‌المثل‌های درس اول، عبارت زیر را با واژهٔ صحیح کامل کنید:
⁦'An empty vessel makes the most _______.'⁩
fa.grading_key: - [1.0] برای تشخیص دقیق و نوشتن املای صحیح واژهٔ پایانی ضرب‌المثل (⁦noise⁩)

en.question:
Based on the proverbs section of lesson one, complete the following statement with the correct word:
'An empty vessel makes the most _______.'
en.grading_key: - [1.0] for precisely identifying and spelling the target idiomatic vocabulary keyword (noise).

tr.question:
Ba tavajjoh be bakhsh-e zarb-ol-masal-haye dars-e avval, ebarat-e zir ra ba vazheh-ye sahih kamel konid:
'An empty vessel makes the most _______.'

textbook.fa: درس ۳: انرژی‌های تجدیدپذیر (واژگان و درک مطلب)

fa.question:
با توجه به مفاهیم درس انرژی‌های تجدیدپذیر، واژهٔ تعریف‌شده در جملهٔ زیر را مشخص کنید:
⁦'Resources like wind and sunlight that are never finished or used up completely are called _______ energy.'⁩
fa.grading_key: - [1.0] برای تشخیص و نوشتن املای صحیح واژهٔ کلیدی (⁦renewable⁩)

en.question:
Based on the concepts of the renewable energy lesson, identify the word defined in the following sentence:
'Resources like wind and sunlight that are never finished or used up completely are called _______ energy.'
en.grading_key: - [1.0] for correctly identifying and spelling the target vocabulary key word (renewable).

tr.question:
Ba tavajjoh be dars-e enerji-haye tajdid-pazir, vazheh-ye tarif shodeh ra moshakhas konid:
'Resources like wind and sunlight that are never finished or used up completely are called _______ energy.'

textbook.fa: درس ۲: نگاهی به آینده (گرامر: جملات شرطی نوع اول)
textbook.en: Lesson 2: Look at the Future (Grammar: Conditional Sentences Type I)

fa.question:
جملهٔ شرطی زیر را با شکل صحیح افعال داخل پرانتز کامل کنید:
⁦'If scientists (develop) clean energy sources, they (save) the environment from global warming.'⁩
fa.grading_key:
- [0.5] برای استفاده از زمان حال ساده در بند شرط (⁦develop⁩)
- [0.5] برای استفاده از زمان آیندهٔ ساده در بند جواب شرط (⁦will save⁩)
fa.final_resolution: ⁦If scientists develop clean energy sources, they will save the environment from global warming.⁩

en.question:
Complete the conditional sentence with the correct form of the verbs in parentheses:
'If scientists (develop) clean energy sources, they (save) the environment from global warming.'
en.grading_key:
- [0.5] for using the Simple Present in the if-clause (develop).
- [0.5] for using the Simple Future in the main clause (will save).
en.final_resolution: If scientists develop clean energy sources, they will save the environment from global warming.

tr.question:
Jomle-ye sharti-ye zir ra ba shekl-e sahih-e fe'l-haye dakhel-e parantez kamel konid:
'If scientists (develop) clean energy sources, they (save) the environment from global warming.'
tr.grading_key:
- [0.5] baraye develop (hal-e sade)
- [0.5] baraye will save (ayande)
tr.final_resolution: If scientists develop clean energy sources, they will save the environment from global warming.

en.question:

textbook.fa: درس ۲: نگاهی به آینده (گرامر: جمله‌های شرطی)
textbook.en: Lesson 2: Look at the Future (Grammar: Conditionals)

fa.question:
شکل صحیح فعل را در جملهٔ شرطی نوع اول انتخاب کنید:
⁦'If scientists develop clean energy, they _______ the planet.'⁩

en.question:

'If scientists develop clean energy, they _______ the planet.'

tr.question:
Shekl-e sahih-e fe'l ra dar jomle-ye sharti-ye no-e avval entekhab konid:
'If scientists develop clean energy, they _______ the planet.'

fa.question: بر اساس متن درس، کدام عبارت بهترین هم‌معنی برای ⁦'clean energy'⁩ است؟

en.question: Based on the lesson text, which is the best synonym for 'clean energy'?

tr.question: Bar asas-e matn-e dars, kodam ebarat behtarin ham-mani baraye 'clean energy' ast?

fa.question:

en.question:

textbook.en: Lesson 1: Sense of Appreciation (Grammar: Active and Passive)

fa.question:
شکل مجهول گذشتهٔ سادهٔ فعل را برای کامل کردن جمله انتخاب کنید:
⁦'A famous children’s hospital in Tehran _______ by Dr. Gharib.'⁩

en.question:

'A famous children’s hospital in Tehran _______ by Dr. Gharib.'

tr.question:
Shekl-e majhool-e gozashte-ye sade-ye fe'l ra baraye kamel kardan-e jomle entekhab konid:
